nodes.text:
🚨 Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is gaining attention amid recent outbreaks in China and rising cases in India.

🦠 This respiratory virus, often mistaken for a common cold, can cause severe complications, especially in children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals.
